questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Which of the following statement(s) is/are true regarding event loop in javascript?
options: The event loop makes sure that each function is processed (or executed) completely before any other function is executed.
The event loop takes the function from the callback queue, and sends the function to the call stack for execution.
The event loop can stop any function in running state to allow some other function to run on priority.
correct_answer: The event loop makes sure that each function is processed (or executed) completely before any other function is executed.
The event loop takes the function from the callback queue, and sends the function to the call stack for execution.
